city.prompt: Distant night city ambience heard from high above, soft low traffic hum and airy wind, calm, no voices, no horns

ping.prompt: Soft clean sonar ping from a smartphone map location marker, a single gentle digital blip with a short airy tail

rise.prompt: Cinematic upward whoosh riser, rushing air that opens into vast silent outer space, airy swell, no impact at the end

space.prompt: Dark cinematic ambient space drone, low evolving synth pad with a slow subtle pulse, documentary tension, no melody, no drums

tick.prompt: Tiny crisp digital interface tick, a data readout appearing on a HUD screen, very short and clean

lock.prompt: Sci-fi HUD target lock-on: three quick rising electronic beeps followed by a short confirming tone

pulse.prompt: Deep resonant radio signal pulse, a sonar-like wave whooshing past the listener with a shimmering electronic tail

typing.prompt: Rapid soft digital data chatter, fast computer terminal readout beeps, clean sci-fi interface

confirm.prompt: Soft positive two-note digital confirmation chime, clean UI success sound

dive.prompt: Fast cinematic downward whoosh, falling from space through the atmosphere, wind rush building toward the ground

land.prompt: Crisp digital location lock ping with a soft low thud underneath, a signal ring snapping onto a map pin, clean and satisfying

error.prompt: Short low digital error buzz, ominous HUD warning tone

glitch.prompt: Digital glitch smear, a GPS location sliding off target, distorted stuttering electronic slide

boom.prompt: Deep cinematic sub boom with a long dark reverb tail, ominous ending hit

monitor-beep.prompt: Single short hospital heart monitor beep, one clean pure electronic sine tone like an ECG patient monitor at a bedside, no reverb, no background noise
